_about.purpose: Graded questions for scoring retrieval and generation against the indexed corpus.
_about.provenance: Every fact was read from the source PDF, not from the search index. That is deliberate: facts harvested from the index could never detect content that ingestion dropped or mangled, because coverage would be 100% by construction.
_about.history: Rebuilt for the current 54-paper library. The previous set covered a 17-paper corpus, of which 8 papers were later removed; 29 of its questions pointed at documents that no longer exist and could only ever score zero.

fields.paper: Filename the fact lives in (single-paper questions only).
fields.mode: absent or 'single' for a fact inside one paper; 'synthesis' for corpus-wide; 'negative' for a control.
fields.key_facts: Groups of surface forms. A group is satisfied when ANY of its forms appears; the score is how many groups are satisfied.
fields.expected_papers: Papers a complete synthesis answer should cite.
fields.why: For negative controls: why the corpus cannot answer this.

_about.corpus: 54 papers on retrieval-augmented generation, information retrieval, text classification, hate-speech detection and clinical NLP.
_about.synthesis_rules: A synthesis question must need at least two papers, have a closed enumerable answer, be answerable without naming a paper, and use fact groups discriminating enough that a fluent non-answer scores zero.
_about.negative_controls: Five questions the corpus genuinely cannot answer, each verified by scanning every chunk for the term: quantum, differential privacy, blockchain, autonomous driving and eye tracking all appear zero times. They measure the failure no other metric here does - inventing content that is absent.

thematic_related_rule: A paper is related to a theme when its own text satisfies at least two of that theme's fact groups without being one of its core papers. One group is too weak: on abstract themes it marks 41 of 54 papers related and the off-theme count stops meaning anything. The earlier rule required most groups, which is what makes a paper core rather than related, so genuine partial engagement was counted as off theme.
